blurb.en: Two functions that look alike on screen and are not: one hands its answer back, the other only shows it.
blurb.zh: 两个在屏幕上看着一样、其实不一样的函数：一个把答案交回来，另一个只是把它显示出来。

en: The names in the def line, width and height, are parameters: empty slots waiting for values. The values written in a call, 3 and 4, are arguments. Each call fills the slots afresh, in order, so the first argument lands in width and the second in height.

return and print are easy to confuse because at the top level both make a number appear. They do different jobs. return ends the function and hands a value back to whoever called it, and that value can be stored, added to, or passed on - which is why rectangle_area(3, 4) + 1 works. print only writes text to the screen; the caller receives nothing it can use.

A function that never reaches a return statement still hands something back: None. That is what the fourth and sixth lines of output are. show_area printed 12, then the caller printed what show_area returned, and there was nothing to return. When an exam answer says a function should calculate a value, it almost always means return it.
zh: def 那一行里的 width、height 是形参：等着装值的空位。调用里写的 3、4 是实参。每调用一次，这些空位就按先后重新装一遍，第一个实参进 width，第二个进 height。
return 和 print 容易混，因为在顶层看起来它们都让一个数出现了。它们干的是两件事。return 结束函数，把一个值交回给调用它的地方；这个值可以存起来、拿去加、再传给别人——所以 rectangle_area(3, 4) + 1 才行得通。print 只是往屏幕上写字，调用方拿不到任何能用的东西。
一个函数走完了都没碰到 return，照样会交回一样东西：None。输出的第四行和第六行就是它。show_area 先打印了 12，调用方再打印 show_area 交回来的东西，而它什么都没交。考题说一个函数「计算」某个值时，几乎总是要你把它 return 出来。

lineNotes.en: This call prints 12 as a side effect, and what gets stored in shown is the return value: None.
lineNotes.zh: 这次调用顺带打印出 12；存进 shown 的是它的返回值：None。

lineNotes.en: Two lines of output from one line of code: the 10 comes from inside show_area, the None from this print.
lineNotes.zh: 一行代码两行输出：10 来自 show_area 里面，None 来自这里的 print。

title.zh: 位置实参、关键字实参与默认值

blurb.en: One function called five ways, and the two ordering rules Python enforces before the program even runs.
blurb.zh: 同一个函数五种调法，外加 Python 在程序运行之前就要查的两条先后规则。

en: A parameter with a default can be left out of a call, and then it takes the default value. That is how make_greeting("Ada") manages with one argument when the function has three parameters.

A keyword argument names the parameter it is for, so its position stops mattering: the fourth call gives name last and still works. Keywords are also the only way to skip over a default you are happy with and change one further along, which is what the third call does with the punctuation.

Two ordering rules, both checked when Python reads the file rather than when a line runs. In a call, positional arguments must all come before keyword arguments - the commented line at the bottom would stop the whole program with a SyntaxError. In a def, parameters without defaults must come before parameters with defaults, for the same reason: otherwise Python could not tell which slot a positional argument was meant for.
zh: 带默认值的形参在调用时可以不给，不给就取默认值。所以函数有三个形参，make_greeting("Ada") 只给一个实参也能跑。
关键字实参点明了自己是给哪个形参的，于是位置就不再要紧：第四个调用把 name 放在最后照样对。想保留前面某个默认值、只改后面一个，也只能靠关键字——第三个调用对标点就是这么做的。
两条先后规则，都是 Python 读文件时就查、而不是等运行到那一行才查。调用里，位置实参必须全部排在关键字实参前面——底下注释掉的那一行会让整个程序以 SyntaxError 起不来。def 里，不带默认值的形参必须排在带默认值的前面，道理相同：否则 Python 分不清一个位置实参该进哪个空位。

lineNotes.en: The parameters are used by name inside the body; the body never knows whether a value arrived by position, by keyword or from a default.
lineNotes.zh: 函数体里按名字用这些形参；它根本不知道某个值是按位置来的、按关键字来的，还是取的默认值。

lineNotes.en: All keywords, in a different order from the def line. Legal, because every argument says where it goes.
lineNotes.zh: 全是关键字，顺序和 def 行不同。合法，因为每个实参都说明了自己去哪。

title.en: Append to a List: the Shared Default Trap
title.zh: 加进列表：共享默认值的陷阱

blurb.en: A function that looks as if it starts with an empty basket every time - and the output that shows it does not.
blurb.zh: 一个看上去每次都从空篮子开始的函数——以及证明它并不是的那几行输出。

en: Read the first four lines of output slowly. The second call was given only "bread", yet it returns a list that still holds "apple". And first, which nobody touched after the first call, has changed too. The last line says why: first and second are the same list object.

A default value is worked out once, when the def statement runs, not each time the function is called. So there is exactly one default list, it is stored with the function, and every call that leaves basket out receives that same list and appends to it. The final line prints add_item.__defaults__, the place Python keeps it, and you can watch it hold everything added so far.

Passing a list explicitly, as the "tea" call does, sidesteps the shared one, which is why that call looks correct - and why the "milk" call afterwards carries on growing the old list. The bug only shows when the default is used twice, so it tends to survive a quick test. Numbers, strings and None are safe as defaults because they cannot be changed in place; lists and dictionaries are not.
zh: 把输出的前四行慢慢读。第二次调用只给了 "bread"，交回的列表里却还留着 "apple"。而 first 在第一次调用之后谁都没碰过，它也变了。最后一行说明了原因：first 和 second 是同一个列表对象。
默认值是在 def 语句执行的那一刻算一次，不是每次调用都重新算。所以默认列表只有一个，它跟着函数存着；每一次不给 basket 的调用拿到的都是这同一个列表，并往里追加。最后一行打印 add_item.__defaults__——Python 存放默认值的地方——你能看到它装着迄今加进去的所有东西。
像 "tea" 那次那样显式传一个列表，就绕开了共享的那个，所以那一次看起来是对的——而之后 "milk" 那次又接着往旧列表里加。这个错只有在默认值被用到两次时才露出来，所以简单试一下往往发现不了。数字、字符串和 None 当默认值是安全的，因为它们不能被就地修改；列表和字典则不然。

lineNotes.en: is asks whether two names refer to the very same object, not whether two objects are equal. True here is the whole bug in one word.
lineNotes.zh: is 问的是两个名字是否指向同一个对象，而不是两个对象是否相等。这里的 True 就是整个 bug 的一个字总结。

lineNotes.en: The tuple of default values the function carries around. Its one item is the list every default call has been appending to.
lineNotes.zh: 函数随身带着的默认值元组。里面唯一的一项，就是每次用默认值的调用都在往里追加的那个列表。

title.en: Append to a List: None as the Default
title.zh: 加进列表：用 None 当默认值

blurb.en: The standard repair for the shared default: the same function and the same calls, with a new list made on every call that needs one.
blurb.zh: 共享默认值的标准修法：同样的函数、同样的调用，只是每次需要时都现造一个新列表。

en: Put this next to mutable-default-trap. The calls are identical; only the def line and two new lines differ. Now each call without a basket prints a list holding just its own item, first and second are different objects, and __defaults__ holds None instead of a growing list.

The idea is to move the moment the list is created. A default is created once, at def time, so the default is set to None, which is harmless to share. The new empty list is created inside the body, and the body runs on every call.

The test is written with is, not ==, and not as a plain truth test. is None asks precisely whether the caller gave nothing. A truth test would also treat an empty list the caller passed in on purpose as if nothing had been given, and quietly swap it for a different list - so the caller's own list would never receive the item.
zh: 把它和 mutable-default-trap 并排看。调用一模一样，不同的只有 def 那一行和新加的两行。现在每次不给篮子的调用打印的列表里只有它自己的那一项，first 和 second 是两个不同的对象，__defaults__ 里装的是 None 而不是一个越长越大的列表。
思路是挪动「造列表」的时机。默认值只在 def 时造一次，所以默认值设成 None——共享它无害。新的空列表在函数体里造，而函数体每次调用都会执行。
判断用的是 is，不是 ==，也不是直接判真假。is None 精确地问：调用方是不是什么都没给。若只判真假，调用方故意传进来的空列表也会被当成「没给」，被悄悄换成另一个列表——于是调用方自己的那个列表永远收不到这一项。

lineNotes.en: False now: each call built its own list, so the two names refer to two different objects.
lineNotes.zh: 这次是 False：每次调用各自造了列表，两个名字指向两个不同的对象。

lineNotes.en: The stored default is None and stays None; nothing is ever appended to it.
lineNotes.zh: 存着的默认值是 None，并且一直是 None；从来没有东西被加进去。

blurb.en: Stars in a def collect arguments into a tuple or a dictionary; stars in a call spread a list or a dictionary back out.
blurb.zh: def 里的星号把实参收进元组或字典；调用处的星号把列表或字典重新摊开。

en: One star in front of a parameter collects every remaining positional argument into a tuple. total can therefore be called with none, one or many numbers; inside, numbers is simply a tuple to loop over. The last function, show, prints what it receives so you can see the shapes directly: a tuple for the positional ones and a dictionary for the keyword ones.

Two stars collect every keyword argument that does not match a named parameter into a dictionary, keyed by the keyword. describe takes name normally and gathers born and field into details. The names args and kwargs are only convention; the stars do the work.

The same stars mean the opposite in a call. One star spreads a list or tuple into separate positional arguments, so a list of three scores becomes three arguments. Two stars spread a dictionary into keyword arguments, its keys becoming the keyword names. That is how the Alan call produces exactly the same shape of output as the Ada call without writing born= or field= at all.
zh: 形参前面一个星号，把剩下的所有位置实参收进一个元组。所以 total 可以不给数、给一个、给很多个；在函数里面，numbers 就是一个可以遍历的元组。最后那个函数 show 把它收到的东西原样打印出来，让你直接看到形状：位置实参是元组，关键字实参是字典。
两个星号把所有对不上具名形参的关键字实参收进一个字典，键就是关键字。describe 照常接收 name，再把 born 和 field 收进 details。args 和 kwargs 这两个名字只是惯例；真正起作用的是星号。
同样的星号写在调用处，意思正好反过来。一个星号把列表或元组摊成分开的位置实参，于是三个分数的列表变成了三个实参。两个星号把字典摊成关键字实参，键成了关键字的名字。所以 Alan 那次调用一个 born= 或 field= 都没写，输出却和 Ada 那次形状完全一样。

lineNotes.en: No arguments at all is allowed: numbers is the empty tuple, the loop runs zero times, and result stays 0.
lineNotes.zh: 一个实参都不给也行：numbers 是空元组，循环一次都不跑，result 保持 0。

lineNotes.en: details is an ordinary dictionary, and keyword arguments keep the order they were written in the call.
lineNotes.zh: details 就是一个普通字典；关键字实参保持它们在调用里书写的先后。

args: (1, 'two')
kwargs: {'three': 3}

blurb.en: A function can only return one thing - and that one thing can be a tuple holding three results.
blurb.zh: 函数只能 return 一样东西——而这一样东西可以是装着三个结果的元组。

en: Writing several values after return, separated by commas, builds a tuple. The function still returns exactly one object; the third line of output confirms it is a tuple of length 3, and printing it whole shows the brackets Python adds when it displays a tuple.

The caller usually unpacks the tuple straight away into one name per value, as the first call does. The number of names on the left must match the number of values, or Python raises a ValueError. The order is fixed by the return statement, not by the names, so calling the first variable high would not make it hold the largest value.
You can also keep the tuple and index into it, as the last line does with result[2]. Unpacking is usually clearer, because low, high and mean say what they are and result[2] does not.
zh: return 后面写几个值、用逗号隔开，就造出一个元组。函数交回的仍然恰好是一个对象；输出第三行确认它是长度为 3 的元组，整个打印出来时能看到 Python 显示元组时加上的圆括号。
调用方通常马上把元组拆开、一个值一个名字，就像第一次调用那样。左边名字的个数必须和值的个数相同，否则 Python 抛 ValueError。先后由 return 语句定，不由名字定：把第一个变量叫作 high，它装的也不会变成最大值。
也可以留着整个元组、用下标取，就像最后一行的 result[2]。一般拆开更清楚：low、high、mean 自己说明了是什么，result[2] 不会。

lineNotes.en: mean prints as 10.0, not 10: the / operator always produces a float, even when the division comes out exact.
lineNotes.zh: mean 打印成 10.0 而不是 10：/ 运算的结果永远是 float，哪怕除得尽。

lineNotes.en: Evidence that one object came back: its type is tuple and it holds three items.
lineNotes.zh: 证明交回来的是一个对象：类型是 tuple，里面有三项。

blurb.en: Three functions, one name: a local that hides the global, a function allowed to change the global, and one that crashes trying.
blurb.zh: 三个函数、一个名字：遮住全局变量的局部变量、被允许改全局变量的函数，以及想改却崩掉的那个。

en: Assigning to a name inside a function creates a local variable that exists only while that call runs. shadow makes its own count and returns 99, and the global count is still 0 on the next line. The local version hides, or shadows, the global one inside shadow and nowhere else.

global count tells Python that inside this function count means the module-level variable, so count += 1 changes the one everyone sees. After two calls it is 2. Use it sparingly: a function that changes a global is harder to test, because its result depends on what every other function did first.

broken looks like increment without the declaration, and fails. Python decides whether a name is local by looking at the whole function before running it: count is assigned in there, so count is local throughout, and count += 1 has to read that local before anything has been stored in it. That is UnboundLocalError. The program catches it only so that it can print the name of the error and carry on; how try and except work belongs to py-files-errors. The error's own message is not printed, because its wording differs between Python versions. The last line shows the global was left at 2.
zh: 在函数里给一个名字赋值，就造出一个局部变量，它只在那次调用运行期间存在。shadow 造了自己的 count 并交回 99，而下一行的全局 count 仍是 0。局部的那个在 shadow 里遮住了（shadow）全局的那个，别处一概不受影响。
global count 告诉 Python：这个函数里的 count 指的是模块顶层那个变量，于是 count += 1 改的是大家都看得见的那一个。调两次之后它是 2。少用它：改全局变量的函数更难测试，因为它的结果取决于别的函数先做过什么。

broken 看上去就是去掉声明的 increment，却失败了。Python 在运行一个函数之前先看完整个函数来决定一个名字是不是局部的：count 在里面被赋过值，所以它在整个函数里都是局部的，而 count += 1 得先读这个局部变量，可它还什么都没存。这就是 UnboundLocalError。程序捕获它只是为了打印出错误的名字、继续往下走；try 与 except 怎么用属于 py-files-errors。错误自带的消息没有打印，因为它的措辞在不同 Python 版本之间不一样。最后一行说明全局变量仍停在 2。

lineNotes.en: Identical to increment apart from the missing declaration - and that one line decides whether count is local.
lineNotes.zh: 除了少一句声明，和 increment 一模一样——而正是那一行决定了 count 是不是局部的。

lineNotes.en: Used here only to show which error was raised without stopping the program; the mechanism is taught in py-files-errors.
lineNotes.zh: 这里只是借它显示抛出的是哪种错误而不让程序停下；这套机制在 py-files-errors 里讲。

blurb.en: Pass a function in, build one and hand it back, or write a small one on the spot with lambda.
blurb.zh: 把函数传进去、造一个函数交回来，或者用 lambda 当场写一个小的。

en: A function name without brackets is just a value, like a number or a list. double(4) calls the function and gives 8; double on its own is the function itself, and it can be passed to another function. apply_twice receives it as func and calls it twice. The last line shows the difference: double is callable, the 8 that double(4) produced is not.

make_multiplier defines a function inside itself and returns it without calling it. The inner multiply remembers factor from the call that made it, even after make_multiplier has finished - this is called a closure. triple is that returned function, which is why its __name__ prints as multiply.

lambda writes a one-expression function without a def and without a name, handy exactly where a short function is needed as an argument. lambda n: n - 1 is the same as a def whose body returns n - 1. Anything longer than one expression should be a proper def.
zh: 不带括号的函数名就是一个值，和数字、列表一样。double(4) 是调用函数，得到 8；单独的 double 是函数本身，可以传给另一个函数。apply_twice 以 func 收下它，然后调用两次。最后一行说明了区别：double 可调用，double(4) 算出的 8 不可调用。
make_multiplier 在自己里面定义了一个函数，不调用它、直接交回。里面的 multiply 记得造它那次调用里的 factor，哪怕 make_multiplier 已经结束——这叫闭包。triple 就是交回来的那个函数，所以它的 __name__ 打印出来是 multiply。
lambda 不用 def、不用名字就写出一个只有一个表达式的函数，恰好适合「这里需要一个很短的函数当实参」的地方。lambda n: n - 1 等于一个函数体交回 n - 1 的 def。超过一个表达式的，就老老实实写 def。

lineNotes.en: factor is not a parameter of multiply; it is looked up in the enclosing call to make_multiplier, and stays available after that call returns.
lineNotes.zh: factor 不是 multiply 的形参；它是到外层那次 make_multiplier 调用里找到的，而且那次调用返回之后依然可用。

lineNotes.en: The lambda is created right here and passed in, just as double was: 10 becomes 9, then 8.
lineNotes.zh: lambda 就在这里当场造出来、传进去，和传 double 一样：10 变 9，再变 8。

blurb.en: Write down what a function does and what it expects - and see that Python stores both but checks neither.
blurb.zh: 写下函数做什么、期待什么——再亲眼看到 Python 两样都存着、一样都不查。

en: A string literal on the first line of a function body is its docstring. Python keeps it in the function's __doc__ attribute, and help() and editors such as PyCharm show it when you hover over a call. Triple quotes are the convention even for one line, so it can grow into several lines later without changing the quotes.

The annotations after each parameter and after -> are type hints. Python stores them in __annotations__, as the third line of output shows, and otherwise ignores them. They are there for people and for tools: PyCharm uses them to warn you before the program runs.

The last two calls prove the hints are not enforced. average accepts a tuple of floats although the hint says a list of ints, and label happily compares two strings, because the >= in its body works for strings too. The answer, fail, is meaningless, and no error was raised. A hint describes intent; it is not a check.
zh: 函数体第一行的字符串字面量就是它的文档串。Python 把它存在函数的 __doc__ 属性里，help() 以及 PyCharm 这类编辑器在你把鼠标停在调用上时会显示它。哪怕只有一行，惯例也用三引号，这样以后扩成多行不用改引号。
每个形参后面、以及 -> 后面的那些标注就是类型注解。Python 把它们存进 __annotations__——输出第三行就是——除此之外一概不理。它们是写给人和工具看的：PyCharm 靠它们在运行之前就提醒你。
最后两次调用证明注解不强制。average 收下了一个 float 元组，尽管注解说的是 int 列表；label 高高兴兴地比较了两个字符串，因为它函数体里的 >= 对字符串也能用。得出的 fail 毫无意义，却没有任何报错。注解描述的是意图，不是检查。

lineNotes.en: A dictionary from parameter name to annotation, with the return annotation under the key return.
lineNotes.zh: 一个从形参名到注解的字典；返回值的注解放在键 return 下面。

lineNotes.en: Strings compare letter by letter: fi comes before fo, so the test is False and the answer is fail. No TypeError, because nothing checked the hints.
lineNotes.zh: 字符串逐个字母比较：fi 排在 fo 前面，所以判断为假，答案是 fail。没有 TypeError，因为没有人查注解。

blurb.en: Return the moment the answer is known, and stop trying divisors at the square root.
blurb.zh: 答案一确定就 return；除数试到平方根就停。

en: Each return ends the function on the spot, so the checks read as a series of exits: numbers below 2 are not prime, even numbers are prime only if they are 2, and the first divisor that goes in exactly settles it as not prime. Reaching the final line means no divisor was found. No flag variable is needed.

Why stop at the square root? If n = a x b and both a and b were bigger than the square root of n, their product would be bigger than n. So any factor pair has one member no bigger than the square root, and if nothing up to there divides n, nothing above it will either. For 97 that means trying 3, 5, 7 and 9 instead of every number up to 96.

math.isqrt(n) gives the whole-number part of the square root exactly, which is what range needs. The + 1 is there because range stops before its end value; without it a number such as 9 or 25, whose square root is itself a divisor, would be reported prime.
zh: 每个 return 都当场结束函数，所以这些判断读起来是一串出口：小于 2 的不是素数；偶数只有 2 是素数；第一个能整除的除数一出现，就断定不是素数。能走到最后一行，就说明没找到除数。不需要标志变量。
为什么试到平方根就停？若 n = a × b，且 a、b 都大于 n 的平方根，它们的积就会大于 n。所以任何一对因数里总有一个不超过平方根；到平方根为止都没有能整除 n 的，再往上也不会有。对 97 来说，这意味着只试 3、5、7、9，而不是一直试到 96。
math.isqrt(n) 精确给出平方根的整数部分，正是 range 需要的。+ 1 是因为 range 在终点之前就停；少了它，像 9、25 这种平方根本身就是除数的数会被判成素数。

lineNotes.en: 0, 1 and every negative number are not prime by definition, and this exit also keeps them away from math.isqrt, which refuses negative numbers.
lineNotes.zh: 0、1 和所有负数按定义都不是素数；这个出口也让它们碰不到 math.isqrt——它不接受负数。

lineNotes.en: Only reached when the loop finished without returning, which means no divisor was found.
lineNotes.zh: 只有循环跑完都没 return 时才会走到这里，也就是一个除数都没找到。

title.zh: 读数报告：自顶向下分解

blurb.en: One task split into parse, summarise and format, each small enough to test on its own, and a main that only joins them up.
blurb.zh: 一个任务拆成解析、汇总、格式化三件，每件小到可以单独测试；main 只负责把它们接起来。

en: Top-down design starts from the whole job - read some readings and report on them - and splits it into steps until each step is one small function with one purpose. parse_readings turns text into numbers, summarise turns numbers into results, and format_report turns results into a sentence. None of them reads the keyboard or prints.

That is what makes them testable. You can call summarise([1.0, 2.0, 3.0]) in the shell and check the answer without typing anything. Only main talks to the outside world: it reads with input(), sends the data through the three functions and prints the report. If the report is wrong, you can test each step separately to find which one is at fault.

Notice that the functions pass data along by parameters and return values, never through global variables. Each function's def line tells you everything it needs, and its return tells you everything it produces. This is the structure an exam answer is rewarded for when it asks you to use subroutines.
zh: 自顶向下设计从整件事出发——读进一串读数、给出报告——一步步拆，直到每一步都是一个只干一件事的小函数。parse_readings 把文字变成数，summarise 把数变成结果，format_report 把结果变成一句话。它们谁都不读键盘、也不打印。
这正是它们能被测试的原因。你可以在交互环境里直接调 summarise([1.0, 2.0, 3.0]) 核对答案，一个字都不用敲给 input。只有 main 与外界打交道：用 input() 读、让数据依次经过三个函数、再打印报告。报告不对时，可以一步一步单独测，找出是哪一步出的错。
注意这些函数之间靠形参和返回值传数据，从不经过全局变量。每个函数的 def 行说清了它需要什么，return 说清了它产出什么。考题要求「使用子程序」时，得分的正是这种结构。

lineNotes.en: Three results in one tuple, the same mechanism as return-several-values.
lineNotes.zh: 三个结果装进一个元组，和 return-several-values 是同一套机制。

lineNotes.at: return f"{count} readings, mean {mean:.2f}, {above} above the mean"
lineNotes.en: Formatting is kept out of summarise, so changing the wording of the report can never change the numbers.
lineNotes.zh: 格式化不放在 summarise 里，于是改报告的措辞永远不会改动那些数。

run.expect: Readings: 5 readings, mean 20.45, 2 above the mean

title.en: Change in Place or Return a New List
title.zh: 就地修改，还是返回新列表

blurb.en: A function receives the caller's own list, not a copy: what that means when it changes the list, builds a new one, or rebinds the name.
blurb.zh: 函数收到的是调用方那个列表本身，不是副本：改它、造新的、给名字重新赋值，各自意味着什么。

en: When a list is passed to a function, the parameter becomes another name for the same list object. Nothing is copied. So add_bonus_in_place, which changes marks through its index, changes original in the caller: the third line of output shows the bonus arrived there.

with_bonus leaves its argument alone and builds a separate result, which it returns. The caller has to catch that return value, and original is unchanged. add_bonus_in_place returns nothing, so returned is None - a common mistake is to write new_marks = add_bonus_in_place(original, 5) and then wonder why new_marks is None.

replace_all shows the limit. Assigning a new list to marks only moves the local name marks to point at a different list; the caller's name original still points at the old one, which was never touched. Changing the object is visible to the caller, rebinding the name is not. Which style to choose is a design decision; what matters is that the function's name and return make it obvious.
zh: 把列表传给函数时，形参成了同一个列表对象的另一个名字。什么都没被复制。所以 add_bonus_in_place 通过下标改 marks，改的就是调用方的 original：输出第三行显示加分到了那里。
with_bonus 不动它的实参，另外造一个 result 并交回。调用方得接住这个返回值，而 original 不变。add_bonus_in_place 什么都不交回，所以 returned 是 None——常见的错误是写 new_marks = add_bonus_in_place(original, 5)，然后纳闷 new_marks 怎么是 None。
replace_all 显示了边界。给 marks 赋一个新列表，只是让局部名字 marks 改指向另一个列表；调用方的名字 original 仍指向原来那个，它从头到尾没被碰过。改对象，调用方看得见；给名字重新赋值，调用方看不见。选哪种风格是设计上的决定；要紧的是函数名和返回值让人一眼看明白。

lineNotes.en: This rebinds the local name only. The caller's list is not changed, and the new list is thrown away when the function ends.
lineNotes.zh: 这只是让局部名字重新指向。调用方的列表没变，新列表在函数结束时就被丢掉了。

lineNotes.en: None: the in-place version changes the list it was given and hands nothing back.
lineNotes.zh: None：就地修改的版本改的是传进来的列表，什么都不交回。
